text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: So close! You almost had it!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Not at all! In fact, nice try!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Watching others play from the sidelines 
was super fresh and heated too!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't change the fact that we had a 
great time together, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
